stem.text: Diagrams X and Y show the passage of water waves around an obstacle and through a gap.
The thick lines are barriers to the waves and each thin line represents a wavefront.

stem.alt: Wavefronts passing a thick barrier, with the diagram labelled X beneath it.
Wavefronts passing through a gap in a thick barrier, with the diagram labelled Y beneath it.

A.text: Diagrams X and Y both illustrate diffraction.

B.text: Diagrams X and Y both illustrate interference.
